tldr: Hundreds have died and thousands are missing after flash floods and landslides struck the Nepal-Tibet border, with scientists linking the disaster to a melting glacier and predicting increased frequency due to climate change.
Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish comments on inflation at Jackson Hole led to a jump in Treasury yields and a dip in stock markets.
The FDA approved a landmark pancreatic cancer drug offering a new treatment approach, and the world's first AI-assisted brain surgery successfully removed a tumor.

market.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite closed lower on August 28, 2026, as investors processed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish remarks at Jackson Hole, where he indicated the central bank still has work to do on inflation.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.72% on August 28, 2026, following Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's keynote address at Jackson Hole, where his hawkish message on inflation suggested potential for further monetary policy action.

vix.why: The VIX closed at 14.43 on August 28, 2026, touching a year-to-date low, as stock traders reacted positively to Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's perceived credibility in addressing inflation.

mortgage.why: The 30-year fixed mortgage rate, as reported by Freddie Mac's weekly survey released on August 27, 2026, increased slightly to 6.66%. This rise tracks the upward movement in the 10-year Treasury yield over recent days, influenced by the Federal Reserve's hawkish stance on inflation.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_week.what_happened: Proposed regulations would provide guidance on employer contributions to Trump accounts and related nondiscrimination rules.
policy_week.effect: Your employer's contributions to your Trump account would be subject to new guidance.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

tech.summary: The world's first AI-assisted brain surgery was successfully performed, resulting in the removal of a tumor that could have caused the patient to lose their sight.
NASA is scheduled to launch its Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope on August 30, initiating a mission to investigate fundamental cosmic mysteries.
The large language model GLM-5.3 has been made open-weight, allowing broader access and development by the AI community.

world.summary: The number of people missing in Nepal has risen to 1,924 following flash floods and landslides, with 584 confirmed deaths in Nepal and five in Tibet, as rescue efforts continue.
Experts have found that forced birth control implemented in Greenland during the 1960s and 70s violated women's rights, prompting the establishment of a truth commission.
Western officials report that Russia is escalating its rhetoric but aims to avoid direct military conflict with NATO, though it is expected to continue its 'hybrid activity' against member states.
The US plans to halt military aid to Iraqi Kurdistan, a key Middle East ally, which could leave the region more exposed to attacks from Iran.

us.summary: A federal appeals court panel ruled in favor of Nevada, affirming its right to regulate the prediction market Kalshi.
Juul received approval to sell an updated vaping device that includes age-gating technology.
A federal judge issued a written order stating that the Pentagon acted illegally by punishing the AI company Anthropic for its criticisms of the Department of Defense's views on AI usage.

science.summary: U.S. health officials have approved a groundbreaking pancreatic cancer drug that targets a protein fueling tumor growth, offering a new treatment approach for the deadly disease.
A melting glacier contributed to the deadly floods in Nepal, and scientists warn that such disasters are likely to become more frequent as the climate continues to warm.
